about: Shares the town and the council rules read, each in a parameter row tagged SOURCED (with citation), ESTIMATED (with source and spread) or TUNABLE (with the spread it is checked against). Read only by src/core2/shares.ts.

sameSexCoupleShare.source: Share of the town's couples who are two women or two men, about 1.3 million of roughly 65 million couple households in the Census Bureau's American Community Survey same-sex couple tables; one rule for every state (Claude CTO ruling, Sept 27, 2026). Inferred, not read from a file in the repository.

evenSplit.source: The even split of a two-way contest: a side with no lean either way takes half. Structural, so its spread is a point.

townPartTimeDefault.source: GAME ASSUMPTION: the share of a workplace's staff who work part-time where its kind has no row below.

councilSize.source: ICMA 2018 Municipal Form of Government Survey, council size, n=3,910; the 8 or more band is spread over the read sizes 8 to 15 (docs/research/chatgpt-answers/2026-09-22-nationwide-2235/).

councilTermYears.source: ICMA 2018 Municipal Form of Government Survey, at-large council terms in years, n=3,254, 'other' left out (docs/research/chatgpt-answers/2026-09-22-nationwide-2235/).

townPartTime.source: GAME ASSUMPTION: the share of each workplace's staff who work part-time, under 35 hours a week. Checked against the national share of about one worker in six.
